lyrics:
[Intro: bouncing piano riff, handclaps]

[Verse 1: cool distant female voice]
Nine o'clock, the east wall
Noon, the palm, that's all
Three, the far umbrella
I move when the light does

[Chorus: piano riff, full house beat]
I'm chasing shade
Wherever it goes, I go
Dragging my chair across the day
Cool and slow
I'm chasing shade
Funny, it's always where you are

[Drop: piano riff, bass and claps, no vocal]

[Verse 2: voice a touch warmer]
You don't burn, you don't rush
You sit like the afternoon's enough
I set my towel a little near
It's ten degrees cooler here

[Chorus: piano riff, full house beat]
I'm chasing shade
Wherever it goes, I go
Dragging my chair across the day
Cool and slow
I'm chasing shade
Funny, it's always where you are

[Break: piano alone, voice dry]
East wall. Palm. Umbrella. You.

[Final Chorus: full beat, extra piano octave]
I'm chasing shade
Wherever it goes, I go
Dragging my chair across the day
Cool and slow
I'm chasing shade
Funny, it's always where you are

[Outro: piano riff, a chair scraping stone]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 122 BPM, 4/4, A minor. A bright, bouncing piano-house groove under a cool voice.

VOICE: Female, cool, clear and a little detached, with a faint Scandinavian evenness. She never raises her voice; the warmth is in the music, not the singing. The break is spoken flatly, like a list.

INSTRUMENTS: A bouncing, syncopated house piano riff, a round four-on-the-floor kick, handclaps on two and four, an open hi-hat on the off-beat, a rubbery bass, a soft organ pad, shakers.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, piano and claps. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:38 Chorus 1. 1:02 Drop. 1:18 Verse 2. 1:42 Chorus 2. 2:06 Break, piano alone. 2:18 Final chorus. 2:44 Outro, piano and a chair scrape, ends 2:58.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2010s nu-disco and piano house: bright, clean and punchy, piano up front, voice dry.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Funny, it's always where you are' at 0:58.

STATION FIT: 3:30 p.m., hot and bright. One of the pack's most danceable tracks, kept cool by the vocal.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Practical, drawn in, amused at herself, settled nearby.
